scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; finite numerical tests are supplementary. No independent mathematical or priority validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Known normal 2x2 damped rotation, fixed first-coordinate sensor, two equal-variance noise observations, deterministic nonadaptive times, initial-state E-optimality. Does not cover arbitrary systems, unequal noise, process noise, or parameter identification. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Globally optimal two-time worst-direction observation of a damped planar rotation
